title: How two ‘objectionable’ books triggered a crackdown on J&K’s varsity and college libraries | Explained
description: Around 251 copies of these books were already circulated among the schools in J&K. The J&K administration said the introduction of these books was a result of “serious negligence, dereliction of duty and lack of proper due diligence”, and blamed the members of the Sub Committee, which approved it.
